price.label: Annual tuition per student
price.currencyDescription: Shown with every amount families see.
price.scheduleDescription: How often families pay this tuition.
price.guide: This is the headline tuition for one student for a full year. Families see it when they ask the school assistant about fees. What each student is actually billed — instalments, transport, uniform — comes from the fee structures in Finance.

free.name: Free
features: Admissions, attendance, exams, fees and timetable

pro.name: Pro
pro.who: For growing schools — pay only beyond 100 students.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.who: For school networks and government contracts.

limits.title: Limits
limits.footer: Choosing Free sets 100 students and 10 teachers. Other plans keep the limits you set here.
limits.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.

summary.title: Annual estimate
summary.allFree: Your first 100 students are free, so there is nothing to pay.
summary.schedule: {signing} at signing, then four payments of {instalment} at months 3, 6, 9 and 12.
summary.enterprise: Above 1,000 students we sign a dedicated contract at the same rate.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.footer: A deactivated school stays saved, but no one — staff, students or families — can sign in until it is reactivated.
dangerZone.deactivateDescription: Stop everyone from accessing the school.
dangerZone.reactivateDescription: Let everyone sign in to the school again.
dangerZone.confirmDeactivateBody: Every user will be signed out and blocked until you reactivate the school. No data is deleted.
dangerZone.confirmReactivateBody: Staff, students and families will be able to sign in again.
